procedures.summary: Keep observations, correlations, hypotheses and reviewed conclusions distinct.
procedures.content: Use only host-returned events and source references as observations. Describe rule-derived links as correlations and retain the rule and evidence references. Record proposed explanations as hypotheses. Promote a claim to a reviewed conclusion only after an analyst review decision; preserve contradictions, missing coverage and clock uncertainty.

procedures.summary: Respect configured sources, case scope, time windows and analysis budgets.
procedures.content: Use only sources configured by the host and available in the current namespace or project scope. Keep collection within the case time window and declared budgets. Treat truncated, timed-out or approximate search results as partial. Never infer that a missing event proves an event did not occur. For uploaded logs, prepare text and call investigation.log.import with an explicit JSONL or CSV field mapping. Use JSON pointers for nested JSON and exact headers for CSV. Preserve rejected records, missing timestamps and parser coverage. Continue bounded pages or resume host-saved progress; never treat a parsed page as complete case coverage. Keep original processor provenance separate from the parser profile.

procedures.summary: Trace an identity through authenticated destinations and nearby events.
procedures.content: Start with an exact user identifier, collect within the case window, then inspect authenticated_to relations and the source events behind each relation. Compare event times and host identity domains. Treat account-name matches across sources as separate unless the source supplies a stable shared identity.

procedures.summary: Trace observed communication while retaining direction and source evidence.
procedures.content: Start from a host or address, expand observed communication relations, inspect the supporting flow events, and compare source/destination fields and time coverage. A network edge establishes recorded communication only; it does not establish propagation, control or causality.

procedures.summary: Construct a time-ordered event chain with explicit clock limits.
procedures.content: Use the bounded temporal_path analysis for a candidate start and target. The host requires relation intervals to be time-compatible. Preserve unknown timestamps, uncertainty and clock limitations; a missing edge is not proof that the event did not occur. Use source-backed timestamps from selected documents and log sources. Preserve whether a time was reported in a document or recorded independently by a system. Do not treat a reported event as an independently observed event. Keep uncertainty and missing time links explicit. Import uploaded structured logs with investigation.log.import before using event algorithms. A document reported_event is a source statement, not an independent log event. Keep event time, reported time, document creation and collection time distinct. Use possible_same_event links only as explicit proposals backed by the anchored reported statement; do not rewrite event identities.

procedures.summary: Follow trace and message identifiers across integration events.
procedures.content: Use exact trace, span, correlation or message identifiers as the join key. Inspect the source event for each step and keep service-to-service ordering bounded by observed timestamps. Do not merge different identifiers based only on similar names or proximity in time.

procedures.summary: Test a proposed explanation against supporting and contradicting events.
procedures.content: State the claim as a hypothesis. Search for evidence that supports it and evidence that would contradict it, record limitations and alternative explanations, and leave the claim unreviewed. Only an analyst can decide whether a conclusion is accepted. Test the hypothesis against source-anchored supporting and contradicting statements and independently recorded events. Keep alternative explanations and unknown coverage explicit. Model comparisons remain proposals; only an authorized analyst can review a conclusion. Use supporting_statement_ids and contradicting_statement_ids for document evidence, separately from supporting_event_ids and contradicting_event_ids for normalized logs. A verified text anchor verifies the quoted text, not the truth of the reported event.

procedures.summary: Freeze a source-linked report from one exact case revision.
procedures.content: Confirm the case revision, then use investigation.report.compose. Preserve event ordering, rule IDs, evidence references, hypothesis state and gaps. The report is a frozen resource; further analysis creates a later case revision and a separately composed report. Freeze the exact case revision. Include each source type, retained content hash, processor version, source-anchored statements, comparisons and source dependencies. Distinguish reported events from independent log observations, preserve hypotheses and gaps, and keep the report immutable. Preserve actor candidates, anchored mentions, proposed evidence links, normalized event positions, parser profiles and import coverage in the frozen source manifest. Historical reports must retain their selected revision when new documents are added.

procedures.summary: Extract source-anchored actor mentions and keep identity matches provisional.
procedures.content: Read only explicitly selected case resources. Propose actor mentions with exact source resource, byte offsets, and verbatim quotes. Distinguish a mention from a resolved identity. Similar names across documents remain separate unless an explicit stable identifier or analyst review supports a binding. Record proposals with investigation.statement.record only after preparing the source text. Supply statement mentions with exact names and absolute UTF-8 byte offsets inside the statement quote. The host creates distinct actor candidates and mention IDs even for equal names. Read actors and actor_mentions through investigation.case.items before proposing possible_same_actor evidence_links. Links require supporting statement IDs and rationale; they do not merge candidates or constitute analyst review.

procedures.summary: Compare source-anchored statements while distinguishing contradiction, qualification, dependency, and uncertainty.
procedures.content: Extract the relevant statements from selected sources with exact anchors. Compare only statements that address compatible actors, events, time ranges, places, and definitions. Mark contradictions only when the statements make incompatible claims under those conditions. Record source citation or retelling as dependency when supported; do not count dependent accounts as independent corroboration. Preserve unresolved comparisons as inconclusive. Compare newly selected sources with earlier saved statements explicitly chosen for this analysis. Use investigation.analyze source_followup for a bounded structural list of unprocessed sources and unexamined source pairs; suggestions are not semantic matches or executable tool calls. A possible_same_event evidence_link may connect a reported_event statement to a selected normalized log event; it remains a proposal and preserves both observations.

procedures.summary: Describe document origin and processing facts without inferring authenticity from writing style.
procedures.content: Inspect host-provided metadata, content hashes, original resource references, processor versions, and available version lineage. Separate verified integrity and processing facts from model-proposed anomalies. Missing metadata is an information gap, not evidence of manipulation. OCR anchors refer to the OCR text representation and do not establish image content beyond that representation.

blueprints.selection_description: Trace an identity through hosts and authentication events.
blueprints.purpose: Establish which configured sources record authentication activity for the selected identity.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked account of observed authentication destinations and related events.
blueprints.success_criteria: Every stated destination is supported by retained source events; uncertain identity bindings and coverage gaps remain explicit.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: For selected uploaded logs, declare a JSONL/CSV mapping and import bounded pages with host-saved progress. Preserve rejected records and unknown times. Search collection and text extraction retain their existing paths.

steps.title: Collect events
steps.objective: Collect a bounded page matching the exact identity.

steps.title: Inspect relations
steps.objective: Expand authentication relations and read their source events.

steps.title: Report findings
steps.objective: Separate observed destinations from hypotheses and gaps.

blueprints.selection_description: Trace observed network communication from a host or address.
blueprints.purpose: Describe source-linked communication paths and their time coverage.
blueprints.goal: Identify the observed peers and supporting flow records for the selected host or address.
blueprints.success_criteria: Relations retain their derivation rule and event evidence; communication is not presented as causation.

steps.title: Select scope
steps.objective: Confirm the host/address, network source and time range.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: For selected uploaded logs, declare a JSONL/CSV mapping and import bounded pages with host-saved progress. Preserve rejected records and unknown times. Search collection and text extraction retain their existing paths.

steps.title: Collect flow events
steps.objective: Collect bounded source/destination records.

steps.title: Expand peers
steps.objective: Inspect graph peers and the evidence records behind each relation.

steps.title: Qualify coverage
steps.objective: Report direction, time coverage, truncation and non-causal limits.

blueprints.selection_description: Find a bounded time-compatible chain between two entities.
blueprints.purpose: Test whether recorded relations form a time-ordered path under explicit bounds.
blueprints.goal: Return a bounded shortest-hop temporal path or an explicit no-path/budget-limited result.
blueprints.success_criteria: Every path edge has source events and compatible event times; incomplete searches are marked partial.

steps.title: Define endpoints
steps.objective: Select start, target and earliest allowed event time.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: For selected uploaded logs, declare a JSONL/CSV mapping and import bounded pages with host-saved progress. Preserve rejected records and unknown times. Search collection and text extraction retain their existing paths.

steps.title: Collect relations
steps.objective: Collect only source records needed to build candidate edges.

steps.title: Search chain
steps.objective: Run bounded temporal path analysis.

steps.title: Inspect proof
steps.objective: Read supporting events and state optimality and clock limitations.

blueprints.selection_description: Follow an exact trace, correlation or message identifier across services.
blueprints.purpose: Reconstruct an integration path from source events that share a stable trace identifier.
blueprints.goal: Describe the observed service/event sequence with its timestamps and source evidence.
blueprints.success_criteria: The path uses exact identifier matches, preserves missing spans and does not invent unobserved service transitions.

steps.title: Select identifier
steps.objective: Confirm exact trace/correlation/message ID and source.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: For selected uploaded logs, declare a JSONL/CSV mapping and import bounded pages with host-saved progress. Preserve rejected records and unknown times. Search collection and text extraction retain their existing paths.

steps.title: Collect spans
steps.objective: Collect a bounded page of exact identifier matches.

steps.title: Order events
steps.objective: Build and inspect the observed time-ordered service path.

steps.title: State gaps
steps.objective: Identify missing spans, clocks and unsupported transitions.

blueprints.selection_description: Evaluate a testable claim against supporting and contradicting evidence.
blueprints.purpose: Keep an explanation as a hypothesis until an analyst reviews the evidence.
blueprints.goal: Record a hypothesis with both supporting and contradicting source references and explicit limitations.
blueprints.success_criteria: The claim remains a hypothesis; model output never records an analyst review decision.

steps.title: State claim
steps.objective: Write a testable explanation and identify alternatives.

steps.title: Seek support
steps.objective: Collect events that would support the claim.

steps.title: Seek contradictions
steps.objective: Collect events that would challenge the claim.

steps.title: Record hypothesis
steps.objective: Store evidence references and limitations without reviewing the claim.

blueprints.selection_description: Freeze a report from a selected investigation case revision.
blueprints.purpose: Create an auditable report resource tied to one immutable case revision.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-linked report containing a timeline, relations, hypotheses and coverage limitations.
blueprints.success_criteria: The report URI and content fingerprint identify a frozen case revision; later analysis does not rewrite it.

steps.title: Confirm revision
steps.objective: Open the exact case revision to freeze.

steps.title: Compose report
steps.objective: Create the frozen source-linked report resource.

steps.title: Review report
steps.objective: Check evidence references, claim states and gaps.

blueprints.selection_description: Compare named actors across explicitly selected source documents.
blueprints.purpose: Record source-anchored actor mentions and proposed relationships without merging identities by name alone.
blueprints.goal: Produce a paginated actor and relationship view with every mention linked to its retained source anchor.
blueprints.success_criteria: Quoted positions are host-verified; proposed identity bindings remain unreviewed and unresolved matches stay separate.

steps.title: Select sources
steps.objective: Confirm the case and the exact authorized documents to compare.

steps.title: Prepare text
steps.objective: Read existing text or invoke the configured host processor for non-text sources.

steps.title: Extract mentions
steps.objective: Save statements with exact anchored mentions. Read host-created actor candidates and mention IDs; isolated candidates are valid even without relationships.

steps.title: Qualify identities
steps.objective: Propose possible_same_actor links with explicit statement evidence. Preserve candidate identities and leave user review to its host-authorized path.

blueprints.selection_description: Compare event descriptions and statements across selected documents and logs.
blueprints.purpose: Find supported agreement, contradiction, qualification, source dependency, and unresolved differences.
blueprints.goal: Record comparable source-anchored statements and explicitly qualified pairwise comparisons.
blueprints.success_criteria: Comparisons cite verified statements, retain source dependency and time uncertainty, and do not equate missing records with disproof.

steps.title: Select sources
steps.objective: Choose the documents and log sources in scope.

steps.title: Prepare source observations
steps.objective: For selected uploaded logs, declare a JSONL/CSV mapping and import bounded pages with host-saved progress. Preserve rejected records and unknown times. Search collection and text extraction retain their existing paths.

steps.title: Extract statements
steps.objective: Preserve the exact wording, source location, actor, and reported time where available.

steps.title: Compare accounts
steps.objective: Compare compatible statements and distinguish conflict, qualification, dependency, and inconclusive results.

steps.title: State limits
steps.objective: Report missing links, unaligned clocks, and incomplete source coverage.

steps.title: Identify incremental work
steps.objective: Inspect structural source_followup suggestions for explicitly selected old and new sources; distinguish unexamined source pairs from asserted matches.

blueprints.selection_description: Inspect origin, versions, and processing history of selected investigation documents.
blueprints.purpose: Summarize verifiable metadata and representation lineage for the case sources.
blueprints.goal: Produce a source-by-source provenance account with explicit metadata gaps and processor history.
blueprints.success_criteria: Integrity facts and processing provenance are host-derived; model-proposed anomalies are not presented as verified manipulation.

steps.title: Select sources
steps.objective: Confirm the exact case resources under review.

steps.title: Inspect origin
steps.objective: Review host-provided content hash, scope, original reference, and available lineage.

steps.title: Inspect processing
steps.objective: Record processor and OCR representation versions, coverage, and limitations.

steps.title: Report gaps
steps.objective: Separate observed metadata from unverified authenticity questions.

artifact_profiles.title: Investigation report
artifact_profiles.purpose: Present one immutable mixed-source case revision with traceable documents, logs, statements, analyses, supported and contradicted claims, and explicit gaps.

sections.title: Scope and method
sections.purpose: Identify the case revision, all source types and versions, applicable time window, and analysis methods.

sections.title: Timeline
sections.purpose: List recorded and reported events in time order while retaining source type, unknown times, and uncertainty.

sections.title: Relations
sections.purpose: Describe observed and rule-derived links with their evidence and derivation rules.

sections.title: Claims and alternatives
sections.purpose: Separate source statements, hypotheses, proposed comparisons and reviewed conclusions; include support, contradiction and source dependency.

sections.title: Gaps and limitations
sections.purpose: Record partial extraction, unavailable OCR, missing metadata, incomplete coverage, and unresolved questions.
